ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white/light grey) base with approximately 30-35% coverage of low-intensity (dark grey/black) focal spots and mottled regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive distribution of discrete dark-pixel circular blobs (10-30 pixels in diameter) across both lobes; higher density of contiguous dark-intensity pixels concentrated at the distal tips and along the trailing edge perimeter.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated internal angle of 35-45 degrees; vertical depth relative to the horizontal lobe span is approximately 12%.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrated boundary with irregular peak-to-valley amplitudes ranging from 10 to 25 pixels; continuous jaggedness observed from the median notch to both distal extremities.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary convex sweep of the outer lobe edges with an upward vertical vector towards the tips; trailing edge follows a non-linear, highly irregular jagged path.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density spatial detection of circular dark-pixel clusters (scars) distributed across both lobes; most prominent groupings are visible in the mid-section and distal-third of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of several short, parallel dark linear pixel disruptions on the right lobe, oriented diagonally (approx. 45 degrees) relative to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant calcified high-contrast protrusions (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips; extensive circular pigmentation anomalies corresponding to secondary scarring from parasitic or epibiotic attachment.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'salt-and-pepper' pixel distribution pattern characterized by a high frequency of discrete, non-contiguous dark focal points across the light-intensity ventral surface.
